theory.body: Metric Granularity describes the methods and patterns used within Data Analytics to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.body: Without Metric Granularity, systems built with Data Analytics are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.body: The mechanism behind Metric Granularity follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Metric Granularity
theory.body: Metric Granularity offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
